records.mission_title: In the Realm of the Gods: Goku
records.conclusion: Independent skill documentation identifies Expert Mission 17 as the acquisition endpoint; GameFAQs discussion independently identifies Spirit Sword with Mission 17. The Steam guide's Mission 17 text says "Spirit Bomb," so it is not used to establish Spirit Sword's reward tier.

evidence_boundary: The 2016 Steam guide is used only as an independent acquisition/reward-tier corroborator.
Spirit Sword uses a separate GameFAQs corroborator because the Steam guide's EM17 text labels the reward as Spirit Bomb and is not treated as authoritative for Spirit Sword's reward tier.
No drop probability, first-clear guarantee, rotation, or additional progression gate is inferred from these sources.
Canonical skill identities and endpoint relationships were not changed.
